spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact IDL member ('type' in GamepadButton.prototype), inspects the readonly-accessor descriptor, and lists the three GamepadButtonType enum values verbatim from spec PR #196 §14.1.1.

interactive.rationale: A real probe button runs the check and renders the live verdict + descriptor; a gamepadconnected listener plus rAF loop prints each button's raw type value from real hardware.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the canonical feature check with descriptor inspection and a live per-button readout; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes no-GamepadButton-interface from interface-present-but-attribute-absent, names the exact missing prerequisite (build with CL 7760763 + GamepadButtonTypes flag), and prints unrecognised enum values verbatim instead of bucketing them.

references.rationale: Links the spec PR anchor and the ChromeStatus entry (chromestatus.com/feature/5075054393163776) in see-also; the feature index carries the full reference set.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts the prototype member, readonly-accessor descriptor semantics, WebIDL enumerable/configurable, back-compat members, plus hardware-only contracts as manual/blocked — the core probes fail honestly (verified: 2 pass / 3 fail / 3 blocked on Chrome 141).

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven headless Chrome 141 run: clicked the probe, captured the unsupported verdict + descriptor screenshot (interact-type-probe.png), zero console errors; the flag-enabled success path and real-hardware readout could not be exercised because no Chrome build with CL 7760763 and no physical gamepad exist in this environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts gamepad-button-type-probe-ran after the primary action, gamepad-button-type-unsupported-fallback on the fallback branch, and gamepad-button-type-live-read for the hardware path; no noisy console output.

design_system.rationale: All colours are styles.css variables; the probe button sets background and color together; verdict/descriptor surfaces are black-on-ivory or ivory-on-black (19.7:1).

accessibility.rationale: Native button with visible focus-visible outline, role=status verdict, aria-live polite readout with aria-label, semantic table with caption and th scope for the enum.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v152/gamepad-button-type-attribute: desktop OK clean, mobile OK; panels stack single-column under 760px, code blocks scroll internally, no horizontal overflow in either screenshot; flagged sub-44px targets are inline prose links, while the probe button exceeds 44px.

openQuestions.title: Verify the supported path on a Chrome build containing CL 7760763
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 141 (this environment) lacks the implementation, so the probe was only verified returning false — with and without --enable-blink-features=GamepadButtonTypes. Once a Canary/Dev build in the 152 timeframe ships the CL, rerun with the flag plus a physical pad and confirm the supported verdict, the descriptor readout (getter, no setter), and the live per-button type strings.

guidanceConsulted.query: aria live region announcing dynamic status updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements; expose dynamic state through role=status / polite live regions; give data tables captions and th scope.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe verdict uses role=status, the hardware readout is aria-live=polite with an aria-label, the enum table has a caption and scoped headers, and all controls are native buttons.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table small screens no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid with a single-column collapse for narrow viewports and keep wide content scrolling inside its own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Two-panel grid collapses to one column at 760px; pre blocks use overflow-wrap/scroll so the 360px viewport shows no page-level overflow (responsive-check mobile OK).

summary: Canonical probe page for GamepadButton.type. Verified headlessly on Chrome 141 via CDP: probe click renders the honest unsupported verdict naming the exact missing prerequisite (build with CL 7760763 + GamepadButtonTypes flag), descriptor readout shows undefined, console clean. Supported path awaits a build that contains the implementation.
